description_en: Updates the name, description, type, documentation, icon, automatic subscription approval setting, product categories, and capabilities of an API product by API product ID. The request body is in JSON format. A successful response returns only the requestId, code, and message, and does not return the updated product information
description_zh: 按 API 产品 ID 更新该 API 产品的名称、描述、类型、说明文档、图标、订阅自动审批、所属产品类别与产品能力，请求体为 JSON；成功响应只返回 requestId、code 与 message，不回传更新后的产品信息
name: UpdateProduct

parameters.help_en: The ID of the API product. This parameter specifies the API product to be updated, which is the primary ID of the API product resource. This parameter is required. You can obtain this ID from the data.productId field in the response of the CreateProduct operation or the productId field of an item in the ListProducts response. This ID is used in the /himarket/v1/products/{productId} path to locate the API product, which is the same path used by the GetProduct, UpdateProduct, and DeleteProduct operations
parameters.help_zh: API 产品 ID，指定要更新的 API 产品，即 API 产品资源 Product 的一级 ID；本参数为必填。可由 CreateProduct 响应的 data.productId 或 ListProducts 列表项的 productId 获得，与 GetProduct、UpdateProduct、DeleteProduct 使用同一个 /himarket/v1/products/{productId} 路径来定位 API 产品
parameters.name: product_id

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to automatically approve subscription requests for the API product
parameters.help_zh: 是否自动审批该 API 产品的订阅请求
parameters.name: auto_approve

parameters.help_en: The list of product categories to which the API product belongs
parameters.help_zh: 该 API 产品所属的产品类别列表
parameters.name: categories

parameters.example: 提供天气查询能力的 API 产品
parameters.help_en: The description of the API product
parameters.name: description

parameters.example: 本产品的调用方式、参数与计费说明。
parameters.help_en: The documentation content of the API product
parameters.help_zh: API 产品的说明文档内容
parameters.name: document

fields.help_en: Indicates whether multimodal input is supported
fields.name: enable_multi_modal

fields.help_en: The maximum number of tokens supported by the model
fields.help_zh: 模型支持的最大 Token 数
fields.name: max_tokens

fields.help_en: Indicates whether streaming output is supported
fields.name: streaming

fields.help_en: The temperature parameter that controls the randomness of the generated output
fields.help_zh: 温度参数（控制生成随机性）
fields.name: temperature

fields.help_en: Indicates whether web search is supported
fields.name: web_search

parameters.help_en: The capability configuration of the API product. Currently, this configuration includes only the modelFeature member, which contains the model, maxTokens, temperature, streaming, webSearch, enableThinking, and enableMultiModal fields
parameters.help_zh: API 产品能力配置。当前只包含 modelFeature（模型能力）成员，其下有 model、maxTokens、temperature、streaming、webSearch、enableThinking、enableMultiModal
parameters.name: feature

parameters.help_en: The icon configuration of the API product, which consists of the icon type (type) and icon information (value) fields
parameters.help_zh: API 产品图标配置，由图标类型（type）与图标信息（value）两个字段组成
parameters.name: icon

parameters.help_en: The name of the API product
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The type of the API product. The valid values are not declared in the API definition. Refer to the types displayed in the console
parameters.help_zh: API 产品类型。取值集合未在接口定义中声明，请以控制台展示的类型为准
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en: The idempotency token. This token is generated by the caller and must be unique to prevent duplicate submissions of the same update request
parameters.help_zh: 幂等令牌。由调用方生成并保证唯一，用于避免同一更新请求被重复提交
parameters.name: client_token
